verdicts.quote: Marro sat on an upturned grain barrel behind the horse lines and worked Rickard's old whetstone along the cudgel's iron cap.
verdicts.reason: Marro has Rickard's old whetstone throughout the scene and Rickard recognizes it in use.

verdicts.quote: The key was on the cord at Rickard's throat. Marro had known that before he started looking.
verdicts.reason: The strongbox stays locked under the cot with the key on Rickard's neck, and the GM notes Marro was never told of the letter, so its location is not revealed or changed.

verdicts.quote: "I said it if the company takes the city," he said. "I remember what I said."
verdicts.reason: Rickard restates the promise with the same condition and reaffirms it rather than changing or denying it.
